Humphrey B. Bear Humphrey B. Bear is an Australian children's television series and its fictional character namesake is an icon of Australian children's television. ""Humphrey B. Bear"" was first broadcast on Adelaide's NWS-9 on Monday, 24 May 1965. The show became one of the most successful programs for pre-schoolers in Australia. The part of Humphrey was originally played by Edwin ""Ted"" Duryea, (c.1930-2009) an actor, singer and dancer whose human identity was never revealed.
